name: Hover Boots
description: Mystical boots that allow the wearer to hover briefly above the ground, crossing gaps, quicksand, and invisible floors. Essential for Shadow Temple and Spirit Temple.

customData.lore: Woven from the silk of phantom spiders by the Sheikah. The wearer walks on air as if on solid ground.
puzzleUses: Walk on quicksand in Spirit Temple
Cross invisible floors in Shadow Temple
